title: Canonical coordinates for nested affine orientations
statement:
Fix a finite purity setting $P$ [def-pur-conventions], its ordinary relative dualizing object and its diagonal shifted Tate objects [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data], using the exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For a separated finite-type smooth morphism $f:X\to Y$ of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], with $Y$ finite type over the fixed field, re-export chartOrdinaryOrientation as the ordinary representative of the specified unique normalized diagonal orientation of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object]. For any compactifiable $f$, re-export chartDualizingUnit, the declaration owned by [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data], as the exceptional image of the inverse canonical isomorphism between the degree-zero coefficient object and the derived tensor unit. For every scheme $B$ and $r\geq0$, re-export chartTraceProjection_smooth, the declaration owned by [def-pur-diagonal-chart-transports], the smooth relative-dimension-$r$ evidence for the recorded ordered affine projection $p_r:\mathbf A^r_B\to B$ [def-sbc-affine-space].

Use the ordinary-etale presentations of derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor] and shifted finite Tate powers [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], with the coefficient-unit comparison of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map]. For a scheme $X$, an abelian Grothendieck symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category $C$ with monoidal preadditivity and functorial flat resolutions, objects $B_n,L\in D(X_{et},C)$, an isomorphism $z:B_0\simeq\mathbf1$, and isomorphisms $s_n:B_{n+1}\simeq B_n\otimes^L L$, re-export compositionEtalePowerAssembly, the existing ordered isomorphism $B_{d+e}\simeq B_d\otimes^L B_e$. Its $e=0$ branch is the inverse right-unit constraint after transport by $z$; its successor branch is $s_{d+e}$, tensor the preceding assembly with the identity of $L$, the associator, then tensor with $s_e^{-1}$. For every commutative ring $A$, natural $N$ with $N A=0$, and scheme $X$, write $T_n$ for the recorded ordered finite Tate power, with its even shift, so $T_0=A_X[0]$ and $T_{n+1}=T_n\otimes^L L_X[2]$. Re-export compositionEtalePowerZero and compositionEtalePowerSuccessor as these existing definitional identifications, and compositionEtalePowerAdd as their ordered assembly $T_{d+e}\simeq T_d\otimes^L T_e$, using the canonical comparison $A_X[0]\simeq\mathbf1$. These seven exports are transparent aliases of the published declarations; they make no new orientation, smoothness proof, tensor product, or choice.
